Description: Without proper entity structure founders are personally liable for ALL business debts and lawsuits. A single lawsuit can wipe out personal savings.
Mitigation: Incorporate LLC or C-Corp before first transaction|Maintain corporate veil (separate accounts, meeting minutes)|Get proper business insurance
When_Needed: Before first dollar of revenue or first contract signed

Description: Covers bodily injury, property damage, and advertising injury claims. Required by most leases and some contracts. $500K-$1M coverage standard.
Mitigation: Get policy through Next Insurance, Hiscox, or Hartford|$500K minimum coverage|Review annually|Required: if you have office, meet clients, or attend events
When_Needed: Before signing lease, attending events, or meeting clients in person

Description: Covers claims that your professional services or advice caused client financial harm. Critical for consulting, SaaS, and agency businesses.
Mitigation: Get E&O insurance if providing services or software|$1M coverage minimum for SaaS|Include cyber liability rider|Review contract indemnification clauses
When_Needed: Before selling software or services to businesses (B2B)

Description: Covers costs of data breaches: notification, credit monitoring, forensics, legal defense, regulatory fines. Average breach costs $4.45M for enterprises.
Mitigation: Get cyber insurance if storing ANY customer data|$1M minimum for SaaS|Incident response plan required by most policies|Pair with SOC2 compliance
When_Needed: Before storing customer PII or payment data

Description: Protects founders/directors/officers from personal liability for management decisions. Required by most VCs before investment.
Mitigation: Get D&O before taking VC funding|$1-2M coverage standard|Insurance follows the person not the company|Review exclusions carefully
When_Needed: Before closing VC round — most term sheets require it

Description: Without proper IP assignment ALL code written by contractors/employees may legally belong to them. Devastating at acquisition or fundraise.
Mitigation: IP assignment clause in EVERY contract (employment and contractor)|Use standard CIIA (Confidential Information and Inventions Assignment)|Audit existing IP ownership|Assign before fundraising
When_Needed: Before hiring first contractor or employee

Keywords: key person,bus factor,succession,single point of failure,documentation
Description: If sole founder is incapacitated, can the business continue? Key person risk kills company value and investor confidence.
Mitigation: Document all critical processes|Share credentials via 1Password/Bitwarden|Key person insurance (life + disability)|Name backup operator|At minimum: documented 'what to do if I disappear' playbook
When_Needed: After product-market fit — before becomes valuable enough to lose

Description: Every B2B contract has hidden risks: unlimited liability, broad indemnification, unreasonable SLAs, IP ownership traps.
Mitigation: Limit liability to fees paid in last 12 months|Cap indemnification|Define SLA with realistic uptime (99.5% not 99.99%)|Never assign IP to customer|Always have mutual NDA not one-way
When_Needed: Before signing first B2B contract over $10K

Description: Misclassifying employees as contractors = massive fines + back taxes + lawsuits. IRS uses 20-factor test. When in doubt: employee.
Mitigation: Use ABC test for contractor classification|Get employment practices liability insurance (EPLI)|Use EOR (Employer of Record) for international hires (Deel, Remote.com)|Document contractor independence
When_Needed: Before hiring first person (employee or contractor)

Description: Industry-specific regulations can shut down your business overnight. Fintech = SEC/KYC/AML. Healthtech = HIPAA. Edtech = FERPA/COPPA.
Mitigation: Identify ALL applicable regulations before building|Budget for compliance (5-15% of revenue)|Consider compliance-as-a-service (Vanta, Drata)|Build compliance into architecture from day 1
When_Needed: Before building product in regulated industry
